BiblicalUsage: Sargon was the king of Assyria who sent Tartan to fight against Ashdod and take it. He is named once, at the head of a prophecy about empires that trusted in men.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God rules over kings who never knew Him, and Sargon is named in Scripture because even Assyria's timetable was God's.
